functional_summary.overview: 3-bit up-counter with synchronous enable. When a=1 the counter holds its value; when a=0 the counter increments by 1 (mod 8) on each rising clock edge. Output q updates one cycle after the sampled edge.
rules: On each rising edge of clk: if a==1, q holds its current value; if a==0, q <= (q + 1) mod 8.
q is a 3-bit register initialized to an unknown value at time 0.
No reset; q retains its value indefinitely while a==1.
Output q reflects the register value after the clock edge (1-cycle latency from input sampling).
